mapper.select: select id, sku, activity_id, lock_surplus, reservation_id, status, create_time, update_time from activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger where sku = #{sku} and lock_surplus = #{lockSurplus} limit 1
select id, sku, activity_id, lock_surplus, reservation_id, status, create_time, update_time from activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger where reservation_id = #{reservationId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger where sku = #{sku} and lock_surplus = #{lockSurplus} and status = 'released'
mapper.update: update activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger set status = 'applied', update_time = now() where sku = #{sku} and lock_surplus = #{lockSurplus} and status = 'reserved'
update activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger set status = 'released', update_time = now() where sku = #{sku} and lock_surplus = #{lockSurplus} and status in ('reserved', 'applied')
mapper.select: select id, sku, activity_id, lock_surplus, reservation_id, status, create_time, update_time from activity_sku_stock_decrement_ledger where sku = #{sku} and status = 'reserved' order by create_time asc
